title: How to Present Your Ideas Effectively

cues.text: If you can conjure up an exciting idea in someone’s mind,
cues.en: If you can conjure up an exciting idea in someone’s mind,

cues.text: you have done something wondrous.
cues.en: you have done something wondrous.

cues.text: A little piece of you has become part of them.
cues.en: A little piece of you has become part of them.

cues.text: Connection, narration, explanation, persuasion,
cues.en: Connection, narration, explanation, persuasion,

cues.text: these are all great tools for sharing your ideas.
cues.en: these are all great tools for sharing your ideas.

cues.text: But the most direct way of gifting an idea  to an audience
cues.en: But the most direct way of gifting an idea  to an audience

cues.text: is simply to show them.

cues.text: You reveal your work to the audience in a way that delights and inspires them.
cues.en: You reveal your work to the audience in a way that delights and inspires them.

cues.text: The basic name for this is revelation— the inspiring act of revealing something.
cues.en: The basic name for this is revelation— the inspiring act of revealing something.

cues.text: In a revelation talk,
cues.en: In a revelation talk,

cues.text: your goal might just be to create a sense of wonder and delight.
cues.en: your goal might just be to create a sense of wonder and delight.

cues.text: If your talk is a demonstration,
cues.en: If your talk is a demonstration,

cues.text: you're probably hoping to amaze and create a new sense of possibility.
cues.en: you're probably hoping to amaze and create a new sense of possibility.

cues.text: If you're sharing a vision of the future,
cues.en: If you're sharing a vision of the future,

cues.text: you want it to be so vivid and compelling that your audience makes it their vision.
cues.en: you want it to be so vivid and compelling that your audience makes it their vision.

cues.text: Let’s dig into three kinds of revelation talks.
cues.en: Let’s dig into three kinds of revelation talks.

cues.text: 1. The Wonder Walk.
cues.en: 1. The Wonder Walk.

cues.text: A wonder walk is a talk based on revealing a series of images or wonder moments.
cues.en: A wonder walk is a talk based on revealing a series of images or wonder moments.

cues.text: It can be like a studio tour with an artist guiding you through each artwork,
cues.en: It can be like a studio tour with an artist guiding you through each artwork,

cues.text: or a hike with an explorer through a dramatic landscape.
cues.en: or a hike with an explorer through a dramatic landscape.

cues.text: Each step is simple,
cues.en: Each step is simple,

cues.text: with a sense of wonder building as you move from one piece  to the next.
cues.en: with a sense of wonder building as you move from one piece  to the next.

cues.text: This type of talk is often used by artists, designers, photographers,
cues.en: This type of talk is often used by artists, designers, photographers,

cues.text: and architects.
cues.en: and architects.

cues.text: David Gallo gave a brief talk on underwater astonishments.
cues.en: David Gallo gave a brief talk on underwater astonishments.

cues.text: He showed a series of incredible images and videos
cues.en: He showed a series of incredible images and videos

cues.text: of bioluminescent sea creatures.
cues.en: of bioluminescent sea creatures.

cues.text: A five-minute talk, it’s been viewed over 15 million times on YouTube.
cues.en: A five-minute talk, it’s been viewed over 15 million times on YouTube.

cues.text: A wonder walk works best with a clear throughline—
cues.en: A wonder walk works best with a clear throughline—

cues.text: a connecting idea that links all pieces together.
cues.en: a connecting idea that links all pieces together.

cues.text: Without that, it can get boring.
cues.en: Without that, it can get boring.

cues.text: The goal is to give the audience an inside scoop.
cues.en: The goal is to give the audience an inside scoop.

cues.text: Using simple language,
cues.en: Using simple language,

cues.text: share your dreams, your process, and mistakes you made along the way.
cues.en: share your dreams, your process, and mistakes you made along the way.

cues.text: Illustrator David McAuley shared his drawings of Rome,
cues.en: Illustrator David McAuley shared his drawings of Rome,

cues.text: showing not just the finished works, but his mistakes and dead ends,
cues.en: showing not just the finished works, but his mistakes and dead ends,

cues.text: and how he got from there to the published illustrations.
cues.en: and how he got from there to the published illustrations.

cues.text: Letting your listeners in on your process
cues.en: Letting your listeners in on your process

cues.text: is one of the major gifts of any creative talk.
cues.en: is one of the major gifts of any creative talk.

cues.text: Don't just walk people through your work.
cues.en: Don't just walk people through your work.

cues.text: Take them on a journey that sparks curiosity and inspires new ideas.
cues.en: Take them on a journey that sparks curiosity and inspires new ideas.

cues.text: 2. The Dynamic Demo.
cues.en: 2. The Dynamic Demo.

cues.text: If what you’re revealing is not just visual—
cues.en: If what you’re revealing is not just visual—

cues.text: like new technology or a novel invention—
cues.en: like new technology or a novel invention—

cues.text: the audience wants to see it in action.
cues.en: the audience wants to see it in action.

cues.text: Jeff Hahn demonstrated multi-touch technology in 2006,
cues.en: Jeff Hahn demonstrated multi-touch technology in 2006,

cues.text: For a dynamic demo,
cues.en: For a dynamic demo,

cues.text: Michael Pritchard started his talk by asking his audience
cues.en: Michael Pritchard started his talk by asking his audience

cues.text: A typical demo journey is:
cues.en: A typical demo journey is:

cues.text: an initial tease, an explanation or context,

cues.text: Exceptional demos can become visions of the future.

cues.text: 3. The Dreamscape.
cues.en: 3. The Dreamscape.

cues.text: Humans have the unique ability to imagine, invent, innovate, design,
cues.en: Humans have the unique ability to imagine, invent, innovate, design,

cues.text: and envision worlds that don’t yet exist.
cues.en: and envision worlds that don’t yet exist.
